faq.q: What is the origin of Tauseef?
faq.a: Tauseef is associated with Arabic. Tauseef is Arabic تَوْصِيف (Tawṣīf), the verbal noun of وَصَّفَ, meaning 'description, praise'.
Yes — the underlying form تَوْصِيف is Arabic.
